# Endzone Empire

> Endzone Empire is a free web app for running private fantasy football and NFL pick'em leagues with friends, plus public rankings, strategy guides and NFL game recaps that need no account.

A league commissioner creates a league and invites friends. Fantasy leagues run a live snake draft with a pick clock and auto-pick, weekly lineups, waivers (priority order or a FAAB budget), trades with league veto, live scoring, playoffs and standings, league chat and commissioner tools. NFL pick'em leagues skip the draft and rosters: managers pick NFL winners each week, straight up or with confidence points. Accounts are only needed to play in a league; the pages below are public.

## Start here

- [Home](https://endzoneempire.gg/): what the app does and how to get started
- [Create an account](https://endzoneempire.gg/#/registration): register to create or join a league

## Free tools and coverage (no account needed)

- [Mock draft simulator](https://endzoneempire.gg/draft-simulator): run a mock draft against CPU managers and get a graded report on every pick
- [Fantasy football rankings](https://endzoneempire.gg/rankings): weekly rankings with projections, season points, recent production and position filters; each ranked player links to a profile page
- [Fantasy football strategy](https://endzoneempire.gg/strategy): evergreen guides on drafting, waivers, trades, lineup decisions and the playoff run
- [Waiver wire guide](https://endzoneempire.gg/waiver-wire): waiver priority, FAAB bidding, streaming tactics and playoff stash strategy
- [NFL game recaps](https://endzoneempire.gg/recaps): final scores, scoring timelines, game summaries and top fantasy performers by week
